incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: TjuaeUI opened, but the local TjuaeCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart TjuaeUI.

incompleteInstallation.title: TjuaeUI installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so TjuaeCore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest TjuaeUI. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined TjuaeCore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest TjuaeUI package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined TjuaeUI components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: TjuaeUI package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This TjuaeUI package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: TjuaeUI opened, but TjuaeCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling TjuaeUI may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: TjuaeUI opened, but TjuaeCore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling TjuaeUI may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: TjuaeUI opened, but TjuaeCore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart TjuaeUI.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: TjuaeUI detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, TjuaeUI will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: TjuaeUI is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another TjuaeUI startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart TjuaeUI.
